g.text: One number for every real row on GPU 0
Flat row number r: e0's rows first, then e1's rows. At most T x topk = 8 x 2 = 16 rows can exist.
Flat row r belongs to the first expert e with s_row_end[e] > r.
Its row inside e is r - s_row_end[e - 1] (0 when e = 0).
so e1, row 5 - 4 = 1, which is t4.
so e1 (empty) is skipped. e2, row 3 - 3 = 0.
Both grids in this post use the same numbering. The total s_row_end[E_local - 1] = 6 is the number of real rows.
The grids differ in how many CTAs compute the prefix sum, and which flat rows each CTA takes (figures 4 and 5).
DSV4-Flash, 4 x B200, b = 64 per GPU
